result: Gateway完善完成。补充了5个方法（health_check到registry和3个provider，get_model_info到ollama），修改了6个文件，添加了Ollama function calling和streaming工具支持、健康检查端点、token计数和成本计算。
features_added: Ollama function calling support (tools parameter with _convert_tools method)
Ollama streaming tool calls support (tool_call type in stream_chat)
Token counting and cost calculation (calculate_cost in all providers)
Health check endpoint /api/v1/gateway/health/ with latency_ms and models_count
OLLAMA_BASE_URL properly read from settings via _base_url field
Model capability detection from Ollama /api/tags response
summary: 三个provider接口已完全对齐。OllamaProvider现在支持function calling（tools参数），所有provider都有health_check()方法，ProviderRegistry有统一的health_check()聚合所有provider状态。Token计数和成本计算已完善：OpenAI/Anthropic按官方定价计算，Ollama成本为0。健康检查端点GET /api/v1/gateway/health/返回各provider的status、latency_ms和models_count。ModelInfo格式已统一，包含model_id、name、provider、model_type、context_window、supports_streaming、supports_function_calling、supports_vision、input_price、output_price。
api_endpoints_added: GET /api/v1/gateway/health/ - Returns health status of all registered providers
provider_methods_aligned: chat(messages, model, temperature, max_tokens, top_p, tools, **kwargs) -> ProviderResponse
stream_chat(messages, model, temperature, max_tokens, tools, **kwargs) -> Generator[Dict]
health_check() -> Dict with status, latency_ms, optional models_count/error
